reconcile.note: Fausset accounts for the Ezra-Nehemiah numeric gaps by the different times and places the two registers were drawn up, plus ordinary attrition.

discrepancy.note: Thomas Paine's Age of Reason (1795) says the Ezra and Nehemiah return lists differ from each other and neither sums to its own stated total.

quotes.text: The list differs in several of the particulars from that of Ezra… These writers may do well enough for Bible-makers, but not for any thing where truth and exactness is necessary.
quotes.attr: Thomas Paine (d. 1809), The Age of Reason, Part II (1795), ch. I, on Ezra 2 and Nehemiah 7.
